description: This file provides platform-specific functions for handling image checks, upgrades, configuration copying, and pre-upgrade steps for a 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi' board within a Linux build system.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables metadata check for specific board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is suitable for the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process tailored for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data for the upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the system before upgrade for specific boards.
